padding_lemma_proof: In the free commutative monoid of multisets, M + S = conj(M) + S iff M = conj(M) (cancellation). conj(M + S) = conj(M) + conj(S) = conj(M) + S for self-conjugate S. Hence chirality(M + S) = chirality(M). QED -- one line, exact.
